say:1:1530204401:0.text: We hunted it ourselves, of course.
say:1:1530204401:0.source_cn: 当然是我们打猎打到的。
say:1:1530204401:0.male: We hunted it ourselves, of course.
say:1:1530204401:0.female: We hunted it ourselves, of course.

say:2:1530204402:0.text: The Halians let us out to hunt, but just a few of us each day. They only pick the warriors whose families are still in Mirehold.
say:2:1530204402:0.source_cn: 呼临人允许我们出去打猎，不过每天能出去的人都是有数的，...
say:2:1530204402:0.male: The Halians let us out to hunt, but just a few of us each day. They only pick the warriors whose families are still in Mirehold.
say:2:1530204402:0.female: The Halians let us out to hunt, but just a few of us each day. They only pick the warriors whose families are still in Mirehold.

say:3:1530204403:0.text: Well, as long as we're not starving, that's enough.
say:3:1530204403:0.male: Well, as long as we're not starving, that's enough.
say:3:1530204403:0.female: Well, as long as we're not starving, that's enough.
